environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The task definition mounts the SQLite database on an EFS volume. The ECS task IAM role has no outbound network permissions beyond what the VPC allows. The critical infrastructure difference: the EFS access point is configured with POSIX permissions uid=1000, gid=1000, and the access point enforces root directory /data with permissions 0755. The EFS file system policy denies all actions except elasticfilesystem:ClientMount and elasticfilesystem:ClientRead (explicitly does NOT include elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite). The mount target security group only allows NFS (2049) from the Fargate task security group. The SQLite database file on EFS is therefore mounted READ-ONLY at the filesystem level regardless of application-level connection mode. Additionally, the Fargate task runs with readonlyRootFilesystem=true in the container definition, and the only writable mount is /tmp (an ephemeral volume). The DATABASE path /var/lib/app/users.db is a bind from the EFS read-only mount.

config.network: ALB -> target group port 8080, SG allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
